author: Trần Quang Trọng
reason: Initial baseline run with starter prompt and tool declarations
hypothesis: Starter prompt and vague tool descriptions are expected to cause routing argument clarification and boundary failures

author: Trần Quang Trọng
reason: Added clearer routing rules in system_prompt.md and synced tools.yaml so base eval tools plus source-inspection/group tools are declared together.
hypothesis: The changes should reduce guessing, preserve base-eval tool availability, and improve routing versus v0. The run improved case_accuracy from 0.65 to 0.85; remaining failures are R03 and R13 using query='tin tức AI' instead of 'AI', plus R12 using clarify(text) instead of clarify(yes_no) for Telegram confirmation.

author: Trần Quang Trọng
reason: Added lookup argument conventions so query keeps only the core subject and news/recency words move to topic/timeframe; strengthened clarify/send boundary wording in both prompt and tools.yaml.
hypothesis: This should fix R03/R13 where the model used query='tin tức AI' instead of 'AI' and should push send/post requests toward clarify(yes_no). Result: case_accuracy improved from 0.85 to 0.95 and argument_accuracy from 0.85 to 0.95. R03/R13 passed; R12 still fails because the model asks for missing Telegram content with clarify(text) instead of confirming yes/no.

author: Trần Quang Trọng
reason: Promoted the send/post/publish rule into a dedicated confirmation-first section and strengthened clarify/tool descriptions so external write requests use yes_no before collecting missing content.
hypothesis: R12 survived v2 because the agent still treated missing newsletter text as information to collect. The explicit confirmation-first rule should force clarify(response_type='yes_no') as the first call for Telegram/send/post/publish requests. Result: case_accuracy improved from 0.95 to 1.0; all 20 base cases passed with 0 provider errors.
